text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, to welcoming our newest crew 
member~...

text_block_list.name: Tap and Crew
text_block_list.text: Cheers!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on, dig in! Eat up the meat, eat up 
the fish, eat till you burst! Don't be 
shy, newbie!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! But still, throwing such an 
extravagant welcome party just for me 
is...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, that's standard procedure when 
welcoming new crew! You're a precious 
comrade we're gonna have a blast with 
every day from now on, right?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
~~~!! Yes! I'll follow you for the rest of 
my life!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Tap-san is so cool after all...! Bold, 
generous, kind—an ideal captain...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah, let's play a game! 'Whitebeard 
Close Call' is a staple at our welcome 
parties!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...That's weird. There aren't enough 
swords to fill the slots.

text_block_list.name: Headband Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Tap~... Did you lose the swords again~? 
Did you put them all away after last 
time~?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I did, but then I might've knocked the box 
over, or maybe just left them lying 
around~...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: Huh? L-Left them lying around...?

text_block_list.name: Sunglasses Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
*sigh* Speaking of leaving things around, 
look over here. What are you gonna do 
about this half-eaten pizza?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ right, that! I didn't forget, I swear! 
I just set it aside for a sec... Ack, it's 
cold!?

text_block_list.name: Sunglasses Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...I'll go heat it up, so wait here. Tidy 
up that game in the meantime.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't look at me like that! I got it, I 
got it~!

text_block_list.name: Headband Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
'The party doesn't end until you're 
asleep,' right? Don't fall asleep standing 
up—let's dry your hair~.

text_block_list.name: Sunglasses Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Don't slack on your skin lotion either. 
Come on, face this way so I can put it on 
you.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~, who cares about just one day~? Stop 
nagging me already~.

text_block_list.name: Blonde Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
No way~! Didn't you say you got water in 
your ear? I brought cotton swabs, so let 
me at your ears!

text_block_list.name: Blue-Gray-Haired Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Here, lift your feet! Put on your slippers 
so you don't catch a chill after your 
bath!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
U-Umm... Isn't this taking it a bit too 
far...?

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Hey, you guys. I kept quiet 
for a bit and now you're fussing over 
every little thing...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
T-That's right, Tap-san!! This is where 
you put your foot down and—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...You guys just love me way too damn 
much~~!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Man oh man~, and I love you guys too! Go 
ahead and pamper me all you want~!

text_block_list.name: Sunglasses Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, honestly, you... You really are 
hopeless, you know that!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: H-Huuuhhhhh...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While taking a walk, I spotted Tap Dance 
City surrounded by a large group of 
people.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Can't help it~. Yesterday I was so tired, 
before I even got into bed I was 
already... *achoo*!

text_block_list.name: Sunglasses Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Told you so... Jeez. Just wait here, I'll 
go buy something warm to drink.

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
S-So this... is... ...the Tap-san I looked 
up to...

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Alright! How about we throw a hot pot 
party today!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
S-So this... is... ...the Tap-san I looked 
up to...
